content:
tom (AE): FYI Lodestar Health asked us to run a short POC comparing lodestar-30b (fp16) vs lodestar-30b-slim4 (4-bit). they care about latency for 600-token responses, cost delta, and whether any KV cache mismatch could break sessions. can we quick-triage?
emily (SE): architecture OK (decoder-only). main checklist: tokenizer token ids, pad/special tokens, and KV tensor naming for the slim4 checkpoint.
han (ML Eng): upload the checkpoint and i'll run a KV + tokenizer diff. typical issues: renamed kv tensors or packed kv layout. perf expectation: slim4 ~20-30% memory drop and ~1.4x throughput on long batches.
tom (AE): uploaded s3://lodestar-poc/lodestar-30b-slim4-2026-03-16.tar.gz.
rick (Infra Eng): i'll spin a sandbox Dedicated canary on A100s. deploy-bot: queued canary deploy sandbox-dedicated-lodestar at 1769020200.
deploy-bot: Job started: canary deploy on sandbox-dedicated-lodestar. logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/1769020200
han (ML Eng): running validation: ```python infra/validate_variant.py --s3 s3://lodestar-poc/lodestar-30b-slim4-2026-03-16.tar.gz --max-seq 1024``` tokenizer mapping OK, KV names slightly different but shapes compatible; will add a loader shim to remap names. numerical drift minimal (~0.18%).
emily (SE): for POC traffic, recommend KV cache enabled + min_replicas=2 to avoid cold P95 spikes.
rick (Infra Eng): autoscale snippet we used: ```scale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 8
  target_rps_per_replica: 5``` will run perf bench for seqs [64,256,600], batch [1,4].
han (ML Eng): preliminary canary perf: fp16 seq600 p50 360ms p95 920ms, slim4 seq600 p50 310ms p95 800ms. memory reduction ~28%.
maya (Sec Ops): security: POC will be de-identified. enterprise note: if they bring PHI later, we require Private deployment + BAA. adding SCC answers: Private supports KMS/HSM, VPC-only, audit logs retained 90d.
emily (SE): action items: han to PR loader shim (EOD), rick to attach perf logs + autoscale recs (2h), maya to draft SCC answers (tomorrow AM), tom to send pricing delta (AE deck) tomorrow.
tom (AE): thanks team. i'll sync Lodestar contact (rachel.p) and propose starting POC on slim4 in Dedicated sandbox with canary 10% -> 100% after 24h smoke. any other blockers?
han (ML Eng): only blocker is loader shim merge; marking `POC-blocker:model-compat` until closed.
__notes: Slack thread for POC model onboarding: lodestar 30B variants, KV/quant compatibility, pricing, and security. Matches agents.md required fields.
